name: Tirailleurs: Trials and Tribulations - From Cannon Fodder to Avant-Garde
description: This exhibition and research project addresses a systematically marginalized history: the African soldiers who constituted the majority of the 250,000 troops in the 'B Army' that liberated Provence and France from Nazi Germany in 1944. HKW's wide-ranging program examines the role of Tirailleurs in liberating France and Germany, their impact on securing peace in Europe post-1945, and how their contributions have been politically co-opted and under-researched. The opening weekend features artist talks, guided tours, panels, concerts including Cheikh Lô, and screenings, with cultural education programs throughout the exhibition run.
